spec: DACS-4 v0.8 profile: §9.5.6 AP2-3/AP2-6/AP2-7 plus CORE §11.1.2 and JID-1
scope: candidate handler predicates: idempotency-key and transaction-id derivation, authenticated synthetic-profile and JID/phase admission ordering, checkout/payment admission atomically composed with handler-owned AP2-7 store decisions, and retry/replay consumption are executed; the fixture release pin is not a published release or live deployment profile; provider capability, mandate cryptographic verification, and signature generation are modeled inputs

vectors.name: ap2-key-base
vectors.note: the same session phase always derives the same lower-case 64-hex provider key

vectors.name: ap2-key-phase-separation
vectors.note: a repeated AP2 phase receives a distinct provider key

vectors.name: ap2-key-job-separation
vectors.note: a different job receives a distinct provider key at the same phase index

vectors.name: ap2-key-noncanonical-unicode-error
vectors.note: a decomposed non-JID-1 identifier refuses before hashing

vectors.name: ap2-key-overflow-job-error
vectors.note: a 130-bit overflow-form ULID refuses before hashing

vectors.name: ap2-key-negative-phase-error
vectors.note: a negative phase index refuses before hashing

vectors.name: ap2-key-string-phase-error
vectors.note: a textual phase index cannot introduce a non-minimal decimal spelling

vectors.name: ap2-transaction-id-sha256-default
vectors.note: an absent CheckoutMandate _sd_alg selects SHA-256 over the exact compact JWS bytes

vectors.name: ap2-transaction-id-sha256-explicit
vectors.note: an explicit CheckoutMandate _sd_alg selects the required SHA-256 algorithm

vectors.name: ap2-transaction-id-signature-byte-change
vectors.note: changing only the merchant signature bytes changes transaction_id

vectors.name: ap2-transaction-id-unsupported-algorithm-error
vectors.note: an unsupported CheckoutMandate _sd_alg refuses before admission

vectors.name: ap2-transaction-id-malformed-compact-jws-error
vectors.note: a value that is not an unpadded three-segment compact JWS refuses before hashing

vectors.name: ap2-admission-complete-chain-match
vectors.note: separate verified CheckoutMandate and PaymentMandate artifacts with a matching digest admit side effects

vectors.name: ap2-composed-same-tuple-inflight-resumes
vectors.note: the composed handler re-dispatches the retained in-flight operation with its exact AP2-6 key and no new-payment authority

vectors.name: ap2-composed-same-tuple-settled-resumes
vectors.note: the composed handler resolves a settled exact-tuple retry without metadata construction or another provider payment

vectors.name: ap2-recovery-lost-response-resubmits-same-key
vectors.note: an ambiguous lost response is retried with the retained exact operation and AP2-6 key, without a new payment authorization

vectors.name: ap2-recovery-reference-reconciles-captured
vectors.note: a retained provider reference reconciles captured status into reusable settlement

vectors.name: ap2-recovery-reference-not-captured-resubmits-same-key
vectors.note: confirmed non-capture permits only a same-key same-operation provider request, never a distinct payment authorization

vectors.name: ap2-composed-cross-job-replay-refuses
vectors.note: a valid current-profile presentation for another session is rejected by the authoritative store before provider work

vectors.name: ap2-composed-cross-phase-replay-refuses
vectors.note: a valid presentation at another phase is rejected by the authoritative store before provider work

vectors.name: ap2-composed-duplicate-bindings-refuse
vectors.note: duplicate authoritative entries fail closed before provider work

vectors.name: ap2-composed-conflicting-bindings-refuse
vectors.note: conflicting authoritative entries fail closed before provider work

vectors.name: ap2-composed-caller-store-assertion-cannot-authorize
vectors.note: a caller-supplied empty-store assertion is ignored; the handler-owned in-flight binding permits only exact retained-operation same-key recovery

vectors.name: ap2-admission-transaction-id-mismatch
vectors.note: a PaymentMandate mismatch rejects before AP2-7 reservation or provider submission

vectors.name: ap2-admission-checkout-mandate-missing
vectors.note: a standalone PaymentMandate is not a complete AP2 checkout chain

vectors.name: ap2-admission-payment-mandate-missing
vectors.note: a CheckoutMandate alone cannot authorize payment

vectors.name: ap2-admission-deterministic-signature-rejects
vectors.note: the DACS strict signature profile is enforced before either side effect

vectors.name: ap2-admission-unsupported-algorithm-errors
vectors.note: unsupported digest selection fails before AP2-7 reservation or provider submission

vectors.name: ap2-admission-noncanonical-job-errors
vectors.note: a non-JID-1 session refuses before hashes, resolution, metadata, binding, or provider calls

vectors.name: ap2-admission-overflow-job-errors
vectors.note: an overflow-form ULID refuses before every modeled job-specific effect

vectors.name: ap2-admission-negative-phase-errors
vectors.note: an invalid phase index refuses before every modeled job-specific effect

vectors.name: ap2-admission-unauthenticated-profile-refuses
vectors.note: trusted context that does not authenticate the expected peer refuses before protocol action

vectors.name: ap2-admission-caller-profile-refuses
vectors.note: matching caller-supplied profile bytes do not substitute for authenticated peer evidence

vectors.name: ap2-admission-duplicate-profile-refuses
vectors.note: duplicate authenticated records for the expected peer fail closed before protocol action

vectors.name: ap2-admission-peer-identity-mismatch-refuses
vectors.note: a current profile authenticated for a different peer cannot authorize this participant

vectors.name: ap2-admission-session-mismatch-refuses
vectors.note: profile evidence authenticated for another session cannot authorize AP2 effects

vectors.name: ap2-admission-copied-profile-reference-refuses
vectors.note: a caller cannot copy a locally meaningful label to manufacture trusted context

vectors.name: ap2-first-presentation-binds
vectors.note: the first valid presentation atomically reserves the transaction for this tuple

vectors.name: ap2-same-tuple-inflight-resumes
vectors.note: an exact retry re-dispatches the retained operation with the same AP2-6 key and no new-payment authority

vectors.name: ap2-same-tuple-settled-resumes-evidence
vectors.note: a settled retry reuses the existing provider result and never counts twice

vectors.name: ap2-recovery-pending-without-reference-resubmits-same-key
vectors.note: lost response recovery retains one operation and its exact AP2-6 key

vectors.name: ap2-recovery-pending-with-reference-reconciles
vectors.note: a retained provider reference is checked before any same-key resubmission

vectors.name: ap2-operation-payload-conflict-errors
vectors.note: same transaction and tuple cannot replace the immutable operation payload

vectors.name: ap2-idempotency-key-continuity-errors
vectors.note: a stored key inconsistent with the reserved tuple fails closed

vectors.name: ap2-cross-job-replay-rejects
vectors.note: one checkout transaction cannot authorize a different DACS session

vectors.name: ap2-cross-phase-replay-rejects
vectors.note: one checkout transaction cannot settle two repeated phases in a session

vectors.name: ap2-conflicting-stored-bindings-error
vectors.note: a corrupt or racy binding store fails closed instead of selecting a winner

vectors.name: ap2-null-binding-store-errors
vectors.note: a null authoritative store snapshot fails closed

vectors.name: ap2-scalar-binding-store-errors
vectors.note: a scalar authoritative store snapshot fails closed

vectors.name: ap2-null-binding-entry-errors
vectors.note: a null store member fails closed rather than raising

vectors.name: ap2-scalar-binding-entry-errors
vectors.note: a scalar store member fails closed rather than raising

vectors.name: ap2-partial-binding-entry-errors
vectors.note: a partial store member fails the closed decision shape

vectors.name: ap2-wrong-type-transaction-id-entry-errors
vectors.note: a non-string stored transactionId fails closed

vectors.name: ap2-wrong-type-job-id-entry-errors
vectors.note: a non-string stored jobId fails closed

vectors.name: ap2-wrong-type-phase-index-entry-errors
vectors.note: a non-integer stored phaseIndex fails closed

vectors.name: ap2-wrong-type-state-entry-errors
vectors.note: a non-string stored state fails closed

vectors.name: ap2-unknown-state-entry-errors
vectors.note: an unknown stored state fails closed

vectors.name: ap2-extra-field-binding-entry-errors
vectors.note: an open-shaped store member cannot add a caller-controlled decision field

vectors.name: ap2-duplicate-stored-bindings-error
vectors.note: even byte-identical duplicate store entries fail closed

vectors.name: ap2-checkout-randomized-signature-pass
vectors.note: the merchant checkout JWT satisfies the DACS strict AP2 signature profile

vectors.name: ap2-checkout-ed25519-reject
vectors.note: DACS chooses AP2 v0.2's stricter branch and rejects deterministic Ed25519

vectors.name: ap2-checkout-deterministic-ecdsa-reject
vectors.note: the security property is non-deterministic generation, not an algorithm label alone

vectors.name: ap2-split-credentials-registration-pass
vectors.note: the privileged key stays local and a distinct status-only key may transit SR-3

vectors.name: ap2-missing-status-credential-reject
vectors.note: an integration unable to provision status-only access cannot register pay-ap2

vectors.name: ap2-shared-provider-credential-reject
vectors.note: one credential cannot serve both the privileged and relayed scopes

vectors.name: ap2-privileged-credential-relayed-reject
vectors.note: a credential capable of creating or moving value must never transit SR-3
